text: Heat beat Jazz 115-109 in Salt Lake City on Tuesday. Heat vs. Jazz is trending because the Miami Heat played the Utah Jazz at Delta Center on Tuesday, Nov. 10, and won 115-109. Interest also centered on the injury reports for both teams, including Giannis Antetokounmpo's status for Miami and Keyonte George's absence for Utah.. The Heat won their Tuesday night game in Utah, 115-109, to finish a five-game, 10-day road trip. Miami had entered the week at 4-6, while Utah was 1-9 and had lost eight straight games before the matchup. Utah played without several key players. Keyonte George was out with an ankle injury, and Jaren Jackson Jr. And Jusuf Nurkić were also listed as out. Lauri Markkanen was downgraded to out before the game. Giannis Antetokounmpo was listed as questionable about 90 minutes before tip-off and then played for Miami.
